kind: Review-authored conceptual diagrams; no source artwork copied

evidence_steps.layout: Parallel questions, not an assay ranking or observed lineage

methods: carbon-14 dating of neuronal DNA with population turnover modeling

questions.limit: Molecular state does not itself establish cell birth, lineage or functional recovery

limits: DCX or PSA-NCAM alone does not date cell birth
Ki67 alone does not establish neuronal fate
RNA velocity and pseudotime infer state relationships rather than directly tracking lineage or elapsed time
birth, survival, differentiation, integration and functional benefit require distinct evidence

recovery_mechanisms.anatomy_scope: Containment diagram only, not an MRI, anatomical cross-section, scale drawing or estimate of relative sizes
limits: Dentate-gyrus findings are not generalized to all injured brain regions
Improved task performance alone does not identify a cellular mechanism
